(I)--a द्वीप, twice the घृतोद in size and surrounded by क्षीरोद (sea of milk) (milk of ghee-मत्। प्।). It takes its name from the क्रौञ्च hill. Greatly despoiled by the arms of Guha but protected by वरुण. Its ruler was घृतपृष्ठ, a son of Priyavrata. He divided it among his seven sons and retired to a life of meditation; Hari is worshipped here in the form of waters.
1: भा. V. 1. ३२; २०. १८-23; M. १३. 7; १२२. ७८.
(Rudra-वि। प्।). Divided among seven Janapadas; twice in size to कुशद्वीप. Described.
2: Br. II. १४. १३-26; १९. ६४-77; वा. ४९. ५९-73.
According to विष्णु प्। Dyutimat was the first king; the four castes here are पुष्कर, पुष्कल, धन्य and तीतिख्यस्।
3: Vi. II. 1. १४; 2. 5; 4. ४५-57.

(II) The hill in क्रौञ्चद्वीप, despoiled by the arms of Guha (कुमार):
1: भा. V. २०. १८-19; Br. II. १९. ६६ and १३९; २५. १८; Vi. II. 4. ६०.
Son (brother-वा। प्।) of Mai- नाक hill.
2: Br. III. १०. 7 and ४८.
The द्वीप takes its name from this.
3: Br. II. १३. ३५; M. १२२. ८१; १२३. ३७; १६३. ८९; २१९. १९; वा. ३०. ३२.
Residence of शन्कर;
4: वा. ३९. ४२; ४९. ६१.
Skanda sent his शक्ति against.
5: Ib. ४१. ३९.
(IV)--a son of Himavat; the क्रौञ्च hill and द्वीप take their name after him. M. १३. 7.
--a place in गया when the sage per- formed austerities in the form of a क्रौञ्च. वा. १०८. ७५, ८३; १०९. १६; १११. ४४ [page१-485+ २७]
--equal to ९०९० years of human calculation. वा. ५७. १८.
--a daughter of ताम्रा, wife of Garutmat. Br. III. 7. ४४६-8, ४५६.
